event.summary: Keep migration regression coverage while migration still ships
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513. TLDR: The intermediate supervisor still upgrades existing tmux sessions into terminal hosts, but this change removes the integration tests checking that the move preserves history, recovers after interruption, and keeps an agent running when its last old tab closes. This is an established test-coverage regression, not an established runtime failure or data-loss bug. Details: deletion of the whole 1,545-line module removes an_old_session_restarts_into_a_host_with_its_history_and_tabs, failed-history-capture and interrupted-move regressions, and a_moved_agent_outlives_its_tmux_session (original parent lines 1345-1471; exact function begins at parent line 1345). At the reviewed commit SPEC_impl.md, Terminal host / Moving an old session into a host (2488-2558), still specifies: 'its liveness, Stop, Restart and Delete ask its host.' Its preceding paragraphs require reading history before removing the old window, refusal on failed history reads, and adoption after interrupted replacement. SPEC.md:3013-3042 still supports old terminals and mixed sessions. The implementation remains: service/core.rs:13054-13061 selects tmux_restart_seed for a tmux predecessor, and service/core/host_restart.rs:763 onward retains capture/seed logic; the host_restart patch primarily removes switch wording and launch_excerpt fields. The removed tests therefore protect still-shipped compatibility behavior at this recorded revision, even though the next series changes later retire it. Source checks: full assigned deletion read; full migration contract read; repository search for tmux_restart_seed, TmuxSeed, old_window, seed/tmux and mixed-session references found no replacement migration tests; core/tests/host_terminals.rs only tests host fixtures, representation mismatches and host relaunch behavior. The commit itself acknowledges adopted tmux tabs have no running-stack test. Suggested fix: retain a legacy-state fixture and migration/mixed-session regressions until the compatibility implementation is removed, without restoring a production tmux-create switch. Suggested bucket: other, because the established consequence is missing regression protection. Could-be-highest: false; no shipped route to losing work is established merely from deleting tests. Confidence: confirmed by source for coverage removal only; execution not performed. Proposed_drop: false. Possible_cover: none; no queue coverage sources read. Material caveat: intentional staged cleanup, and the later commits remove this compatibility path; do not present this as an endpoint runtime defect.

event.summary: Migration regression coverage was removed before its behavior retired
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513. TLDR: At this intermediate revision the supervisor still moved existing tmux agents into terminal hosts, but deleting this suite removed its integration regression checks for preserving history, recovering interrupted moves, and keeping the migrated agent alive when its last old tab closed. The exact subject of those tests was subsequently retired before pinned tip 00de0b6c9cf206f1a7c9c5ad1c76b5b10eaf85db; this is not a current endpoint request to restore obsolete migration tests. Original defect preserved: the 1,545-line deletion removes happy-path migration, failed capture, interrupted move and mixed-tab regression protection while that implementation and contract still existed at 647f0227. In particular parent host_migrations.rs:1345-1454 checks a_moved_agent_outlives_its_tmux_session. SPEC_impl.md:2488-2558 still required migration, safe history copying, failed-read refusal, interrupted adoption and host-only lifecycle after losing the last tmux tab; its exact text includes 'its liveness, Stop, Restart and Delete ask its host.' SPEC.md:3013-3042 still supported mixed old and new terminals. service/core.rs:13058-13063 still dispatched a tmux predecessor to tmux_restart_seed, implemented in service/core/host_restart.rs:763 onward. Searches across supervisor/e2e source found no surviving test executing the actual transition. The remaining core/tests/host_terminals.rs:40-68 checks incomplete tab discovery using a stand-in host with no old tmux session, so it cannot replace this oracle. Sound-looking implementation alone does not refute that lost regression protection. Later resolution, established from source and changed contract: dbfc69751215dbf15e1d31d5bed73c3754c4ebc4 changes SPEC.md:3003-3019 to end old terminals at startup, close their tabs, mark live old agents interrupted and restart into empty terminals. Exact text at 3016: 'After an update to this release, Restart, Clone and Replace start such a session in a new, empty terminal.' Next commit 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333 removes the migration implementation itself: host_restart.rs diff hunk -710,223/+484,12 deletes tmux_restart_seed, its pane-history capture, timeout retry, capture-size and seed-refusal path; hunk -593,33/+388,12 deletes the Replacing::TmuxWindow old-window-removal arm, and earlier hunks delete TmuxSeedFault, Replacing::TmuxWindow and From a tmux pane documentation. At pinned tip, SPEC_impl.md:2780-2823, Ending the old private tmux server, states at 2799-2801: 'The reload then takes every old-kind row as having no terminal, in any state, without looking its recorded pane id up' and converts live rows to interrupted. Actual tip startup source service/core.rs:6141-6149 invokes OldTerminals::end_private_server before reload. Endpoint search finds no tmux_restart_seed or Moving an old session into a host contract. Therefore the intermediate missing migration oracle remains a true historical coverage loss, but its exact behavior no longer ships at endpoint, so no endpoint migration-coverage fix is established. Suggested bucket: other (test regression protection only). Could-be-highest: false; no runtime data-loss or security route established. Confidence: confirmed by source for intermediate coverage loss and later subject retirement; no runtime observation. Proposed_drop: false; parent owns recording and coverage disposition, and no drop is treated as accepted. Possible_cover: none; other group names supplied by the parent are interface context only, not evidence of queue coverage. Checks: all 1,563 assigned mandatory lines redelivered in turn 2 as separate raw-stdout evidence packets <=200 lines and <24,000 encoded bytes; later commit diffs, complete endpoint retirement contract and startup call inspected. No tests, builds or reproductions run. No unresolved premise for this record's stated historical-only consequence.

event.summary: Removing the viewer-stream argument preserves relaunch coverage
event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e. TLDR: No issue established: the revised relaunch regression still attaches to the agent, checks a restart detaches its viewer, and decodes the replacement terminal's history and screen. Details: the assigned patch only removes ViewerStreams::BytesOrGrid from the attach_terminal call. At this revision crates/farhelm-helm/src/client.rs:3967-3976 defines the five-argument method and forwards the same terminal selector, lease and displacing policy. Its implementation at 4007-4074 always uses GRID_EVENT_QUEUE, constructs Attach without a stream discriminator, accepts Attached and starts grid flow. The changed test at host_relaunches.rs:1546-1599 still calls grid_until_caught_up (1498-1532), which decodes every data frame as GridOutput, checks the restart detach reason, checks socket replacement, waits for the resumed screen, and checks history plus absence of the old visible frame after reattachment. Thus removing the argument cannot silently select a byte stream or weaken those assertions at the reviewed revision. Suggested bucket: other if there were a test issue; could-be-highest: false. Confidence: confirmed by source only. Proposed_drop: no changed behavioral or test-contract defect; API migration matches the sole grid stream. Possible_cover: none. No tests or reproductions run. Governing restart contract is SPEC_impl.md, Terminal host / Restarting a host agent, especially its viewer-detach and reattach rule (2302 at this revision); its full subsection is being read as contract corroboration.

event.summary: Deleted Clone/Replace test adds no distinct surviving create-oracle loss
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513. Discovery pass 1 considered whether removing clone_and_replace_of_an_old_session_create_host_sessions also removes a surviving Clone/Replace terminal-host-create oracle, separate from known l1's old-terminal migration gap. TLDR: No additional defect established. The deleted test's distinguishing subject is an old tmux source staying in tmux after a create, and ending when deleted; ordinary host-backed creation keeps a direct real-process regression test. Source: deleted host_migrations.rs:1474-1545 calls create_session_with_extras twice using only old.session.launch and cwd, checks each new runtime is a host, checks the source remains a tmux row/pane after the first create, then checks deletion removes the old source and leaves the second runtime alive. It does not call a special Clone/Replace endpoint. Remaining host_creates.rs:241-288, a_create_starts_its_agent_in_a_terminal_host, actually creates through the supervisor, waits for screen readiness, asserts stored TerminalKind::Host and running outcome, verifies its recorded socket matches the published runtime and sole socket, verifies no tmux session exists, checks live listing and that Stop ends the child while leaving the host's final screen. Thus there is still an executed-path oracle for normal creates choosing hosts; source correctness alone is not the refutation. Exact governing SPEC.md Lifecycle operations at this revision states Clone starts 'a brand-new, independent create through the same form' and Replace 'creates a new session ... and then DELETES the source.' The removed test models those ordinary creates rather than extending create with source terminal kind. Its distinct old-source/mixed-runtime responsibility is preserved under existing l1 and retired later as that record details; this candidate does not refute or lower that original intermediate coverage loss. Suggested bucket: other for the considered test-only gap. Could-be-highest: false; no product data-loss, security or catastrophic tooling route established. Confidence: confirmed source analysis. proposed_drop: no additional finding beyond l1; retained real-host create assertions refute the narrower suspicion that deleting this test removes the sole host-create oracle. possible_cover: host_creates.rs:241-288 as directly inspected test source, not queue coverage. Caveat: no claim that this test covers every combined Clone/Replace contract or GUI flow; reviewing unrelated clone/replace behavior would exceed this assignment. No runtime test, build or reproduction performed.
